scripts.purpose: Runs on a server and creates a gzip-compressed tar archive of that server's own directories. Settings come from USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG, the installed config, or the repository's remote/config template. install.sh deploys both this script and remote/config to each host in REMOTE_SERVERS; no local orchestrator is involved. Open question: help text advertises --wait-for-dbus while the parser accepts --wait-for-notification-daemon.

arguments.name: -h|--help
arguments.description: Print usage and the option list, then exit 0.

arguments.name: --dry-run
arguments.description: Skip archive creation and verification; report the archive path that would be produced.

arguments.name: --wait-for-notification-daemon
arguments.description: Wait in 60-second intervals until dunst, mako, xfce4-notifyd, or notification-daemon is running.

arguments.name: --notify-send
arguments.description: Send a desktop notification after completion; exits 1 when no notification daemon is running.

environment.name: USER_SCRIPTS_CONFIG
environment.description: Explicit config path; takes precedence over the installed config and remote/config. An unreadable explicit path is an error.

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.description: Base directory for the installed config lookup.

environment.name: HOME
environment.description: Base for config-defined paths and exclusions.

exit_codes.meaning: Help printed, dry-run completed, or archive created and verified; a notification is sent when requested.
Config file unreadable, unknown option, a BACKUP_SOURCES directory missing, archive creation or verification failed, or no notification daemon running with --notify-send.
